policies.description: the V0.3 protocol demonstration (agent.Greedy): raises one radiologist's site reading allocation by 5 points whenever the oldest unread study is over a day old; not a strategy
a modest rule-based baseline: reading allocation follows the reading backlog with hysteresis, every change validated and previewed first

a financially conservative baseline (V0.6b): raises a site reading allocation only after three days in a row with the oldest unfinished study over a day old, within a 5-point cap, a $50,000 cash floor and the trailing 30 days' operating profit after the change's cost; waits 14 days after each change; steps back when that profit is negative or the backlog has been clear for a week
